title: Maze Paths (Down and Right Only)
statement:
Given an N×M grid where 0 means open and 1 means a wall, count the number of paths from the top-left (0,0) to the bottom-right (N-1,M-1) moving only right or down.

This restriction (only 2 directions instead of 4) makes the problem tractable for larger grids via DP.
inputFormat:
The first line contains N and M.
The next N lines each contain M space-separated integers (0 or 1).
outputFormat: A single integer: the number of down/right paths from top-left to bottom-right.
constraints:
1 <= N, M <= 10
0 <= grid[i][j] <= 1
Start (0,0) and end (N-1,M-1) are always 0.

examples.explanation: C(4,2)=6 paths in a clear 3x3 grid with only down/right moves.
